args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment of checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions with an elevated error rate (~18%). Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: service is healthy again on v2.3.0 with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the failed health checks is identified. Note: v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging only.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions are now running **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (note: v2.3.1-rc was only ever healthy in staging).
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is healthy again, with the error rate down from 18% to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident**: **INC-0001** documents the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback, and verification — the on-call engineer has been paged.
